stemMd: A rectangular block has width 8, depth 5 and height 3. Its front view looks along the depth direction. What dimensions appear in that orthographic view?
explanationMd: Looking along depth removes depth from the projection. Width and height remain visible, giving a rectangle 8 by 3. Orthographic projection does not add perspective scaling.

distractorRationale.b: The height is not equal to the width.
distractorRationale.a: Neither front-view dimension is represented correctly.
